messages:
amelia: Quick weekly check-in for Galileo onboarding — dropping p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Noticed a small uptick in p99 for the chat route on the large model.

latency-bot: Automated summary for /accounts/galileo (last 7d):
```
route   model       mode        p95(ms)   p99(ms)   errors(5d)   spend($)
chat    gpt-large   streaming   420       860       0.12%        1,250
chat    gpt-large   sync        380       490       0.08%        1,040
qa      gpt-small   streaming   120       200       0.02%        180
qa      gpt-small   sync        95        130       0.01%        150
```

amelia: Flags — streaming p99 on chat/gpt-large is the one that popped. customer reported slow threads when they hit bursty traffic during their import job last week.

david: I dug into traces — for streaming requests the KV cache miss rate spikes on long conversations (seq>1024) which pushes execution to slower kernels. The runtime falls back to non-quantized path at ~1% of tokens which adds latency.

amelia: Is that something we can mitigate quickly? Maya — customer is asking for a timeline, they're worried for go-live next month.

david: Short term: enable `prefer-prefix-cache: true` for their tenant and a soft cap on max_stream_window=2048. That should drop p99 ~20-25% for chat streaming. I can roll canary tomorrow.

sanjay: FYI SRE saw two infra rebalances in the cluster during their peak on 2026-03-18 03:14 UTC which increased tail latencies across a few tenants. We should pin Galileo's Dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor rebalances while onboarding.

maya: Customer feedback: they said "fine for now but if latency doesn't stabilize we may delay next phase" — sounding like a moderate renewal risk. They want a joint CS+Eng triage this week.

amelia: Action items:
- @david: schedule canary config (prefer-prefix-cache + max_stream_window) and post metrics after 24h.
- @sanjay: evaluate pinning to a dedicated pool or reserve burst capacity for the import window.
- @maya: set up joint call with Galileo for Friday EOD PT, include engineering.

david: I'll push canary tomorrow morning and post updated p95/p99. If we hit the expected delta I'll prepare a runbook for enabling the config in prod for this account.

sanjay: I'll check infra rebalancing windows and propose a short-lived pin. If pinning not possible, we'll add routing policy fallback to gpt-large-sync during high contention.

maya: I'll schedule the call and share the customer's sample prompts so eng can reproduce. Also capturing feedback: they're noticing tokenized input variability causing occasional longer seq lengths — planning a short prompt refinement doc with them.

amelia: Thanks team. Please post results in this thread. If p99 for chat/streaming drops below 650ms after canary we mark health as "on track"; if not, escalate to a hotfix. :white_check_mark:

latency-bot: Note: next automated report scheduled in 7 days.

amelia: Closing for now; reminder to drop brief numbers back here after canary (p95/p99 + error delta + spend delta).
